purpose: Controlled identical-input comparison with evaluator-visible built site files and approved responsive screenshots.
constants: downstream builder configuration at producing commit
copy facts, imagery policy, viewport checks, and quality gates

liveExecution.reason: The harness is offline-only; a separately approved runner records complete provenance without credential access.

humanGate.rule: Two distinct named human evaluators must independently submit complete blind scores with evidence for every rubric area, each bound to the immutable v2 presentation packet, before unblinding.

blinding.normalization: Unicode NFKC, lowercase, then remove non-letter and non-number characters before matching
blinding.presentationRule: Only requiredPresentationArtifacts are copied. Text must be valid UTF-8 and leak-scanned; screenshots must be PNG without textual or EXIF metadata. Full-set validation completes before atomic immutable publish. provenance.json stays coordinator-only.
blinding.neutralizationRule: Replace producer/provider/model/path identity, timestamps, latency, token use, cost, URLs, and local paths with neutral evidence identifiers. Full values remain in provenance.json for post-score audit.
